recorder.how: A relay-connected Userspace VM (engine release 236743e9…, Chromium, image from base-rootfs.tar: Node 24.18.1 on musl) ran this script under the guest's own Node (OXIDEVM_ACCELERATION=off, placement linux/placement-override). The VM's resolver (192.0.2.1, UDP 53) was the relay test peer answering from `zone`; TCP port 53 is refused by the relay policy. Harness: /home/deploy/Work/oxidevm-sdk/.cache/spike-dns (run.sh, probe.cjs section `lookup`, overlay/tests/browser/relay-test-dns.ts). `udpConnect` is the local address a datagram socket reported after connecting to each destination (probe section `sources`).
recorder.variants: cb: dns.lookup(name, cb) → [address, family]; all: promises.lookup(name, {all:true}); f4/f6: {family}; f4all/f6all: {family, all:true}; v4first/v6first: {all:true, order}; addrconfig: {all:true, hints: ADDRCONFIG}; f6mapped: {all:true, family:6, hints: V4MAPPED}; f6mappedall: {all:true, family:6, hints: V4MAPPED|ALL}
